purpose: Machine-readable anti-entropy contract for AI-assisted iKant development. It records executable/constitutional baseline truth, unresolved engineering ignorance, modeled coverage, physical-boundary oracles, supply-chain assumptions and the ordered semantic roadmap. It is control-plane state, never world evidence.
unitary_intent: Make runtime/component identity explicit and durable without confusing component provenance with iKant identity, evidence, actor authentication or authority; preserve a repository-verifiable development lineage before memory, temporal-task, planning or external-provider capabilities are expanded.
functioning_definition: one declared semantic runtime truth per lifecycle phase
every behavior-changing durable object can be reconciled to its runtime/session/component epoch
component/model replacement changes provenance epoch but never the identity label iKant
hash chains prove bounded local integrity only unless an external authenticated attestation supply chain exists
UI claims no capability stronger than its concrete technological supply chain
every material DoD claim has an oracle at the browser, OS, provider or Git boundary it names

modes.DEVELOP: Continue the next prerequisite-satisfied semantic slice with atomic commits and executable oracles.
modes.ANTI_ENTROPY_REVIEW: Re-audit repository, bundle, contracts, supply chain and physical-boundary evidence before adding capability.
modes.HANDOFF: Update exact SHA/PR/CI/finding truth so a fresh session can resume without conversational memory.

iteration_protocol.rule: A fresh session loads AGENTS.md, IKANT_DEVELOPMENT_BUNDLE.json, PRODUCT_CONTRACT.json and the current slice before code changes; modeled coverage never substitutes for physical-boundary receipts.
